extraction_notes: Catalog seed MPN SI2302-HXY is retained. The exact -HXY suffix is not printed in the supplied PDF; the PDF identifies SI2302, HUAXUANYANG/HXY, SOT-23, N-channel operation, VDS = 20 V, ID = 2.8 A, and package marking A2SHB. Identity is established from the catalog seed plus compatible base-family, manufacturer, package, ratings, and marking evidence.
Curve points are direct compact digitizations from the p. 3 and p. 4 raster plots; no points were interpolated between plotted readings.
The transfer figure does not state VDS; this condition is preserved as not stated rather than inferred.
The capacitance table values are transcribed separately from the Fig. 10 curve readings; the figure itself does not state gate bias or test frequency.
The RDS(ON) table publishes both typical and maximum values for both VGS conditions; duplicate schema entries preserve both source semantics and inclusive maxima.
omission_reason: No required MOSFET schema field was omitted; transfer, output, on-resistance, and capacitance curves were extracted from the supplied figures.
